about:
Alaska Alloy LLC operates from Sterling on the Kenai Peninsula of Alaska. The company was established in 2015 as a locally owned and operated fabrication business.

The shop provides a range of metalworking services including precision TIG welding, production MIG and stick welding, CNC plasma cutting, CNC tube and sheet metal bending and forming, milling, turning, and metal finishing such as powder coating and specialty paint. It also offers electrical system design and fabrication, gate fabrication with automation, architectural production, and mobile welding services. The facility handles both small and large scale manufacturing projects.

Alaska Alloy serves residential, commercial, industrial, construction, fishing, and trucking sectors. Project examples include foundation jacks for Arctic Slope duplexes, structural and architectural metalwork for Grizzly Ridge Design Build, custom interior stair railings, natural gas fire features, and automated gate systems for commercial and residential properties.

The company was started to fill a need for premium quality products and services from concept through installation. Its stated differentiator is the ability to transform ideas into reality, managing the full project scope from design and estimating to fabrication and finishing.

name: All-State Plastics
old_description: All-State Plastics is a trusted plastic injection molding company that has been helping businesses transform concepts into high-quality products since 1972. We specialize in custom plastic injection molding, mold making, precision machining, and end-to-end manufacturing solutions for companies seeking dependable production partners.
about:
All-State Plastics operates from City of Industry, California, where it was founded in 1972. The company remains family-owned, with leadership noting that the family tradition continues under new management.

The shop provides custom plastic injection molding, mold design and mold making, precision machining for both plastic and metal components, rapid prototyping, and a range of secondary operations including assembly, drilling and tapping, ultrasonic welding, painting, printing, plating, gluing, and specialized packaging with bar coding. These capabilities allow the company to handle projects from prototype development through production.

Its customer base spans aerospace, dental equipment, paint manufacturing, housing, and construction sectors. The company works with business owners, manufacturers, and engineering teams seeking prototype-to-production support.

All-State emphasizes its Sensational Service Package (SSP), which promises direct access to production and engineering teams, seamless communication, and flexible manufacturing solutions. A documented quality system underpins operations, featuring first-article inspection at the start of every operation, in-process checks throughout runs, and final inspection before shipment. The firm has invested in new molding machines, tool room machinery, and auxiliary equipment since 1992, and has built custom automation for certain molding jobs.

old_description: Alpha Packaging, Inc. was founded in 1987 and is the largest independently owned corrugated box manufacturing company in Arkansas. At home in Greenwood, Arkansas our facility has a manufacturing capacity of 200,000 square feet on 27 acres. Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery, capable of creating virtually any style container, including triple wall and plastic corrugated.
about:
Alpha Packaging, Inc. was founded in 1987 in Greenwood, Arkansas, as a family-owned corrugated box manufacturer. It has grown to become the largest independently owned corrugated box manufacturing company in the state, operating from a 200,000-square-foot facility on 27 acres.

The company produces a wide range of packaging solutions, including custom corrugated containers (slotted, telescope, folder, rigid, self-erecting, and interior forms), triple-wall and plastic corrugated boxes, foam inserts, and printed packaging. Its capabilities encompass design and prototyping using ArtiosCAD software, foam fabrication with heat welders, saws, and die cutters, custom printing, and vendor-managed inventory (VMI) services. The facility houses over 100 employees and maintains an online catalog of more than 13,000 ready-to-ship products, along with packaging equipment from brands such as 3M, Lantech, and EMBA.

Alpha Packaging serves manufacturers, food processors, retail packagers, and other industrial markets across a 300-mile radius, delivering via its own fleet of trucks. Its customer base includes businesses shipping consumer, commercial, and industrial goods that require protective packaging, regulatory-compliant labeling, and sustainable solutions.

The company differentiates itself through its GMP certification with a 99% audit score, membership in the AICC, and a commitment to U.S.-based manufacturing. Its 200 years of combined staff experience, in-house design engineering, and real-time VMI stock monitoring are cited as key advantages for reducing lead times and material waste.

name: Alsco Uniforms
old_description: The pace of life might be slower in Casper than in other parts of the country, but its business owners still care about quality and customer service. That’s why many businesses in the greater Casper area, including Mills and Evansville, rely on Alsco Uniforms for their uniform rentals. As the company that started uniform rentals in the late 1800s, we set a high standard for quality and service. Our heavy-duty workwear uniforms for industrial and manufacturing sectors serve a dual purpose: they present a professional image and protect workers against environmental hazards. Our restaurant uniforms create a unified appearance that can be matched with table linens, enhancing the dining experience. For the healthcare sector, we offer a comprehensive range of uniforms, including scrubs and lab coats, tailored to meet specific needs. Alsco Uniforms also provides restaurant linens and hygienically clean bed linens to ensure a safe and welcoming environment for guests. In addition to uniforms and linens, we supply first-aid kits, washroom supplies, and a catalog of floorcare equipment and supplies—including both branded and non-branded floor mats—to support businesses in Casper and nearby areas.
about:
Alsco Uniforms operates from Casper, Wyoming, where it has served the greater Casper area — including Mills and Evansville — since its founding in 1889. The company traces its roots to the late 19th century when it pioneered the uniform rental business, establishing a model that continues to define its service today.

The business provides uniform rental programs for industrial, manufacturing, healthcare, automotive, and food-service sectors, supplying heavy-duty workwear, scrubs, lab coats, and restaurant attire. Beyond apparel, Alsco delivers linen services such as table linens and hygienically cleaned bed linens, along with first-aid kits, washroom supplies, floorcare equipment, and branded or non-branded floor mats. Local teams manage scheduled deliveries and inventory replenishment from a regional facility.

Customers span healthcare facilities, automotive shops, industrial plants, food-processing operations, restaurants, and hospitality venues. The company tailors rental programs to each industry’s requirements, offering unified invoicing and dependable service schedules to keep facilities stocked without interruption.

Alsco emphasizes hygienically certified cleaning processes, a national network backing local service, and sustainability initiatives that include energy-efficient laundering and smarter logistics. With over 135 years of experience, the firm positions its longevity and standardized hygiene systems as key differentiators for businesses seeking reliable textile and facility support.

name: Amboseli Foods LLC
old_description: Founded by Sylvia, the company is built in Layton, Utah, where hands-on production and quality control shaped a more exacting standard. Amboseli Foods values warmth, usefulness, and follow-through in equal measure — because flavor is only worth building if it holds up in real life.
about:
Amboseli Foods LLC operates from Layton, Utah, where founder Sylvia Kapsandoy built the company on lived food memory and disciplined production. The name references Amboseli National Park in Kenya, reflecting a heritage rooted in Kenyan food culture rather than trend. What began as a home-kitchen idea grew into a food manufacturing business grounded in hands-on quality control and a standard of warmth, usefulness, and follow-through.

The company produces spice blends and consumer brands, most notably the USimplySeason® line, designed to make bold global flavor accessible for everyday cooking. Its capabilities span seasoning development, bulk blend production, private label manufacturing, and full product experience design including packaging and use-moment details. Production emphasizes sensory clarity and repeat use, with a focus on practical, approachable flavor products.

Amboseli Foods serves retail, hospitality, and food-service channels, working with food brands, retailers, entrepreneurs, and media partners. The firm frames its collaborations as strategic food partnerships for organizations building lasting food work, offering seasoning development, private label opportunities, and practical food business consultation.

The venture was started on the belief that flavor should help people cook with confidence, not confusion. Kapsandoy's founder-led approach stresses cash-flow discipline, customer feedback loops, and patient, self-funded growth. The company highlights its NMSDC certification and memberships in Utah's Own and ByBlack as verification of its community roots and operating standards.

name: American Apparel
old_description: American Apparel is a leading manufacturer of combat and utility uniforms for the United States armed services. Operating four highly automated manufacturing facilities in Alabama, American Apparel has an unequaled record of flexibility, superior quality, and on-time delivery. Since 1987, American Apparel has responded to the surge requirements necessary to meet the needs of our armed services, meeting all government specifications and providing the maximum level of protection to the war fighter.
about:
American Apparel Inc. was founded in 1987 in Selma, Alabama. The company operates four highly automated manufacturing facilities in the state. No founders are named in public materials, and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The company manufactures combat and utility uniforms for all branches of the U.S. armed forces — Air Force, Army, Navy, Marines, and Coast Guard — along with shirts, blouses, pants, skirts, all-weather coats, treated fabrics, and accessories. Its services include warehousing and distribution for military and Department of Defense logistics agencies, as well as prototyping and custom hand-sewing for special measurements. Across its Alabama facilities, American Apparel has produced more than 4,300 SKUs across 195 product groups and fulfilled over 210 contracts in the past two decades.

Primary customers are the United States military and Department of Defense logistics agencies. The company supplies garments directly to each service branch and supports surge requirements for deployed personnel.

American Apparel emphasizes its ability to meet government specifications on accelerated timelines, citing an unequaled record of flexibility, quality, and on-time delivery since 1987. The firm was established to respond to the surge requirements necessary to protect the war fighter.

name: American Cable Assemblies
old_description: American Cable Assemblies, is a privately-owned, US-based manufacturer of both standard and custom, high-quality fiber optic cabling, copper assemblies, & power cords. Our products reflect more than 25 years of innovative design, and quality manufacturing experience in the assembly of standard and complex fiber optic cable assemblies, copper cable assemblies, and custom power cords. solutions. We have a quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and our products are UL and CSA listed. American Cable Assemblies personnel are to meet IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship standards.
about:
American Cable Assemblies is a privately owned manufacturer based in Palmer, Massachusetts. The company has been producing cable assemblies for more than 25 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. It operates as a US-based producer of standard and custom cable solutions.

The company manufactures fiber optic cable assemblies, copper cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and injection-molded power cords. Its product range includes pre-terminated fiber distribution cables, MTP/MPO trunk and breakout cables, fiber patch cables in singlemode and multimode variants, and copper assemblies from Cat5e through Cat8, along with industrial Ethernet M12 connectors. Power cord offerings cover NEMA, IEC, and international configurations, plus EV charger extension cords. The firm also supplies fiber enclosures, patch panels, cable management accessories, media converters, and SFP transceivers.

American Cable Assemblies serves customers across the United States and Canada, with a regional focus on New England. Its products are used in telecommunications infrastructure, data center power and connectivity, industrial automation networks, and electric vehicle charging installations. The company also provides telco-style assemblies such as 110 and 66 blocks for legacy voice and data systems.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, UL and CSA listed products, and adherence to IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship standards. All manufacturing is performed in the United States, supporting a 'Made in USA' proposition for OEM customers seeking domestic sourcing.

old_description: American HomePatient® specializes in the provision of ventilator equipment and aids. Our program enables the ventilator-dependent patient to have as much normalcy as possible in their life. We are committed to providing clinical support for patients and educational assistance for caregivers.
about:
American HomePatient operates from Dover, Delaware, providing respiratory and home medical equipment services across the United States. The company has served patients for over 25 years, specializing in ventilator, oxygen, and sleep therapy equipment for home-based care.

The company supplies a range of durable medical equipment including ventilators, CPAP machines, oxygen systems, nebulizers, and enteral nutrition products. Through affiliated entities, it also offers pharmacy services dispensing FDA-approved pharmaceuticals, home INR testing, and wound care supplies. Services include disease management programs, clinical support, and caregiver education tailored to physician prescriptions.

American HomePatient serves patients with chronic respiratory conditions, obstructive sleep apnea, and mobility limitations in home settings. Its customer base includes ventilator-dependent individuals, those requiring long-term oxygen therapy, and tube-fed patients needing nutritional support. The company works with caregivers and healthcare providers to manage therapy programs for conditions such as COPD, sleep apnea, and acute or chronic wounds.

The company emphasizes clinical support and customized therapy programs over simple equipment delivery, aiming to improve health-related quality of life for homebound patients. Its affiliated pharmacy network and in-home testing services extend care beyond standard DME provision, with programs designed to give patients as much normalcy as possible in their daily lives.

name: American Leather Operations, LLC
old_description: At American Leather®, we believe that exceptional furniture begins with thoughtful design, unmatched craftsmanship, and a commitment to innovation. Since 1990, we’ve redefined what it means to create custom, made-to-order furniture, handcrafting every piece in our Dallas, Texas facility. From the revolutionary Comfort Sleeper® to versatile accent chairs and motion furniture, our collections are designed to elevate your home with timeless style, unparalleled comfort, and endless customization options. Whether you’re hosting guests or creating your perfect retreat, American Leather® offers furniture that’s as unique as the moments it helps you create.
about:
American Leather Operations, LLC was founded by engineers in 1990 in Dallas, Texas, on the conviction that a twelve-week wait for custom furniture was too long. What began as a small team in a borrowed facility has grown into a privately held manufacturer employing more than 700 people in a 350,000-square-foot factory in Dallas.

The company handcrafts made-to-order residential and contract furniture, including sleeper sofas, motion sofas, recliners, stationary pieces, and accent chairs. Its Dallas facility produces frames from sustainably harvested wood, offers over 500 leather and fabric upholstery options, and uses water-based pigments and fire-retardant-free foams and fabrics. All leather scraps are recycled or resold, and the operation is a founding member of the Sustainable Furniture Council.

American Leather sells through more than 700 retail partners across the United States and supplies contract-approved collections for commercial and hospitality projects. Its customer base includes independent furniture retailers, interior designers, and contract specifiers who require customizable, domestically produced seating.

The business was started to compress lead times from concept to delivery, and it continues to emphasize speed, quality, and customization. A central U.S. location reduces shipping time and carbon footprint, while a workforce representing 35 countries supports a culture of innovation and sustainable manufacturing.
